notes.title: Big Update!: Version 0.8
notes.content:
The BIG update is here! This update introduces you to the game story!

In this version:
 - Game story for the first three chapters
 - Enhanced game menus
 - Highly polished level structures
 - Enhanced game graphics
 - New combat features for Kuro
 - The first two boss fights
 - Enemy introduction cutscenes
 - New music
 - Full leaderboard integration for the new levels
 - Game hints
 - 3 Difficulty levels for the game
 - Various bug fixes

notes.title: Steam Workshop integration is here!
notes.content:
Now you can easily share your levels with the rest of the players and enjoy running and slashing in their dojos!

Version 0.7.0 is available and includes the following:

- Steam workshop integration, Upload level, browse and download+menus 
- Steam Cloud for user profiles and game saves
- Leaderboard global score paging
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: More Challenging Levels, Leaderboards, Achievements
notes.content:
Big update, version 0.6.6 added new challenging levels, leaderboards (see who is the better Ninja among your friends!), achievements (the first round) and the following:

First set of achievements added! More to come.
Fixed second time going to Dojo editor without exiting game
All Hardcore and Masterclass levels of Chapter 1 (Dojo)  Added
First 4 Hardcore and Masterclass levels for Chapter 2(Jade city) Added
Polished some of Chapter 1 levels, based on videos and heat maps
Basic Leaderboard for Levels
Performance optimization of level selection screen
General graphic improvement
